invariants.contract: The play method is direct play when every audio file mime type is supported or forceDirectPlay is truthy, otherwise a single HLS track; forceDirectPlay wins over forceTranscode and the iOS string flags work.
A new session starts at the current progress time, at zero for a user without progress and at zero for a finished item, and follows later progress changes.

The session deviceInfo and the devices row follow the client description: Android, iOS, web by user agent, explicit client name, sanitised strings and a missing device id. Playing again with a known client deviceId reuses the devices row and rewrites its description to the new client data instead of creating a second device.

A second play by the same user and device closes the previous session first: it is saved, no longer open, announced with user_session_closed to the owner's sockets only, and only the new session stays open. A play on another device or by another user leaves the earlier session open, and one user can hold several sessions at once.

Item tags decide who may play: an allow-list user needs a matching tag, a deny-list user must not have one, and untagged items are refused to the first and allowed to the second. An explicit item is refused with 403 to a user without explicit-content access once the item is marked explicit, and stays playable for a user with access.
